summary: Iteration 10 verification of (1) barcode persistence into db.foods with id='bc_{barcode}', source='barcode', brand populated, and (2) new pack-flow UI on scan screen (pack-nutrient-panel / pack-log / pack-favorite / pack-logged-flash / barcode-rescan). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_barcode_persist_and_pack_flow.py. POST /api/scan/barcode {barcode:'3017620422003'} → 200, matched_food_id='bc_3017620422003' (persisted, not seed-matched); GET /api/foods/bc_3017620422003 → food.source='barcode', food.brand='Nutella', food.name='Nutella (Nutella)'. Meal-log create with meal_type='snack' → 200, food.id echoes bc_id; GET /api/meal-logs?date=today lists it; GET /api/meal-logs/summary reflects Na=42.8mg & protein=6.3g from the log (see note). Favorites toggle round-trip works: POST /api/favorites/bc_id → is_favorite=true, GET /api/foods?favorites_only=true includes bc_id, second POST → is_favorite=false. Idempotency verified: second POST /api/scan/barcode returns identical matched_food_id (upsert by 'id' field). Regression: /api/scan/food (unauth)=401, /api/foods?q=palak works, /api/ai/ask lang='bn' returns non-empty answer, /api/reports/weekly returns 200. Frontend (Playwright mobile 390x844, camera pre-granted): Sign In → 'I understand' disclaimer → home renders (Namaste, Demo User, safety chips, favorites, food cards). Scan tab → default vision mode shows 'Scan a food / Take a photo of any dish. AI will identify it and check kidney safety.' with scan-take-photo shutter. Tapping scan-mode-barcode swaps the subtitle to 'Point the camera at a packaged food's barcode. We'll check kidney safety from Open Food Facts.' and shows web placeholder 'Barcode scanning is available on the mobile device. Open this app on your phone via Expo Go.' + 'Align the barcode inside the frame' overlay hint (confirmed via 3 screenshots at /tmp/iter10_scan_*). Toggling back to scan-mode-vision restores the shutter. 0 console errors. 1 recurring RN warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — same one flagged in iter9 (scan.tsx L309 uses `[styles.barcodeOverlay, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]` — the deprecation lint fires because RN-Web's Web target still sees `pointerEvents` traversed as a prop when applied via array-style; requires refactor to a plain `style.pointerEvents` key on the base style object). NOTE: pack-* testIDs (pack-nutrient-panel, pack-log, pack-favorite, pack-logged-flash, barcode-rescan) are code-reviewed as correctly wired (scan.tsx L321-385) but cannot be exercised in the web preview because the CameraView never emits onBarcodeScanned on Platform.OS==='web' — this is expected per the PRD and is unblockable in Playwright. All new pack-flow endpoints (log 'snack' with bc_id, favorites/bc_id, foods?favorites_only=true) ARE fully tested at the API layer and confirmed functional.

react_native_issues.issue: Recurring since iter9 — still uses deprecated inline `pointerEvents: 'none'` inside style array on the barcodeOverlay wrapper. React Native Web logs: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move to a StyleSheet entry (e.g. barcodeOverlayNoPointer: { pointerEvents: 'none' }) or Platform-specific web style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/scan.tsx:309

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Fix the pointerEvents deprecation warning on scan.tsx L309 — the same issue reported in iteration_9 was not addressed. Refactor `[styles.barcodeOverlay, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]` to include pointerEvents in the StyleSheet.create object.

(Informational) OFF returns 0 potassium and 0 phosphorus for Nutella (barcode 3017620422003) as of the OFF snapshot; only sodium and protein are populated. If the demo needs a visible K/P value for screenshots, seed a different barcode with populated micronutrients (e.g. an Indian packaged snack) — this is a data limitation, not a code bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L876-1005 /api/scan/barcode: barcode-sourced persistence is correctly idempotent — `food_id = f'bc_{barcode}'` + `db.foods.update_one({'id': food_id}, {'$set': food_doc}, upsert=True)` means multiple scans of the same barcode never create duplicates. Verified via test_h.

server.py L942-948 seed-match guard: the regex-based override only matches when `source != 'barcode'`, preventing a self-match loop where a previously-persisted bc_ food could shadow a fresh scan. Safe.

server.py L191-195 FoodOut model: `brand: Optional[str]=None` and `source: Optional[str]=None` correctly added; L399-400 maps them from Mongo docs. GET /api/foods/{bc_id} returns both fields. Verified.
scan.tsx L52-63 mount-time getMealSummary: correctly lazy-loads limits once, silently swallows errors so barcode UI still functions offline. Good defensive pattern.

scan.tsx L165-191 doLogPack / doToggleFavorite: correctly gated on `!result?.matched_food_id || actionBusy !== 'none'`, disabling double-taps and preventing null-id API calls. After doLogPack, limits are re-fetched so pack-nutrient-panel would update if user scans a second pack. Good.

scan.tsx L92-99 switchMode: on mode toggle, clears photo/result/error/lastScannedRef AND (implicitly via state) will re-mount pack-flow UI on next scan. But note: `favorited` and `logged` state are NOT reset in switchMode — only in `reset()`. Minor risk: if a user scans pack A, logs it, switches to vision mode without pressing 'Rescan', then switches back and scans pack B, the green 'Added' pill would falsely appear until Rescan is pressed. Suggest clearing favorited/logged in switchMode too.
api.ts L199 favorites_only correctly forwards to backend query param; backend L559 filters by user_favorites list. Round-trip verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable-on-web flows (mode toggle, subtitle swap, web placeholders, shutter restore); pack-flow UI code-reviewed only — cannot fire onBarcodeScanned on web

seed_data_creation: TestBarcodePersistence upserts a barcode-sourced food doc (bc_3017620422003 / Nutella) into db.foods. This is intentional and persistent across runs (idempotent). The transient meal-log entry from test_d is deleted in teardown_class. Favorite state is left at is_favorite=false (toggled twice).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Backend env var: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo convention). 2) Camera permission MUST be granted BEFORE navigating: `await page.context.grant_permissions(['camera'], origin=<preview_url>)` — otherwise the scan permission-request UI hides scan-mode-* chips. 3) React Native Web mounts all tab screens simultaneously — `document.body.innerText` on any tab returns content from Home + all other tabs. Do NOT assert visibility by text presence; use testID selectors + is_visible() OR screenshots. 4) On web preview the barcode camera cannot fire onBarcodeScanned — pack-flow testIDs (pack-nutrient-panel, pack-log, pack-favorite, pack-logged-flash, barcode-rescan) render ONLY after a successful scan. They are code-verified but not runtime-testable via Playwright. To test in the future, either (a) stub api.scanBarcode to return a mock FoodScan then trigger it, (b) call the API directly and inject result via a debug hook, or (c) use Expo Go on-device with the app. 5) Sign-in button label is 'Sign In' (not 'Login'). 6) Idempotency of /scan/barcode is by `id` field ('bc_{barcode}'), not by `barcode` field — Mongo query for count uses id, not barcode. 7) Nutella OFF data: sodium=42.8mg, protein=6.3g, potassium=0, phosphorus=0. If a test needs non-zero K/P, use a different barcode.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found this iteration. One data caveat noted (OFF Nutella lacks K/P). One pre-existing minor RN deprecation warning carries over from iter9.
